svg.title: WP-S-08 Figure 4-1: integration test cases
svg.desc: Integration test cases: IT-01 Monitor self-diagnostics, secure boot and fail-silent output at IS-1 in ENV-2, exercising CMP-02; IT-02 Monitor supply after a fault of the Autoware computer's supply at IS-1 in ENV-2, exercising CMP-10; IT-03 Longitudinal envelope against its model at IS-1 in ENV-2, exercising CMP-02; IT-04 Lateral envelope against its model at IS-1 in ENV-2, exercising CMP-02; IT-05 Stop, hold, release and indicator logic at IS-1 in ENV-2, exercising CMP-02; IT-06 Command streams from Autoware and remote operations at IS-3 in ENV-2, exercising CMP-01, CMP-02, CMP-11; IT-07 Safety channel detection at IS-2 in ENV-3, exercising CMP-02, CMP-03, CMP-04, CMP-05; IT-08 Safety channel false detections, per sensor at IS-2 in ENV-3, exercising CMP-03, CMP-04, CMP-05; IT-09 Safety channel diagnostics and secure boot at IS-2 in ENV-2, exercising CMP-02, CMP-03; IT-10 Physical attacks on the safety sensors at IS-2 in ENV-3, exercising CMP-03; IT-11 Autoware's stop when the safety channel fails at IS-3 in ENV-2, exercising CMP-01, CMP-02; IT-12 Autoware computer's cybersecurity functions at IS-3 in ENV-2, exercising CMP-01; IT-13 Bounded command and the vehicle's own stop at IS-4 in ENV-4, exercising CMP-02, CMP-06; IT-14 Achieved against commanded on the vehicle at IS-4 in ENV-4, exercising CMP-02, CMP-07; IT-15 Park brake and doors at IS-4 in ENV-4, exercising CMP-02, CMP-08, CMP-09; IT-16 Collision signal at IS-4 in ENV-4, exercising CMP-02, CMP-07; IT-17 Minimal risk manoeuvre and the sensing-to-actuation chain on the track at IS-4 in ENV-4, exercising CMP-02; IT-18 Remote driving over the real cellular links at IS-4 in ENV-4, exercising CMP-01, CMP-02, CMP-11.
svg.text: What each integration test runs on, and what it proves
WP-S-08 §4, Figure 4-1: each case on the architecture as it stands at its step (faint not yet integrated, grey integrated, outlined added at
the step, filled exercised by the case), its environment, methods, coverage, time budgets and pass criterion. No case has been run.
